description: No objective pile that has few weaknesses...
strategy:
Didn't copy that much...just took 1 paragraph...revised it then posted it... I have alot of new cards...

General Strategy:

Play like any mains deck, but you usually generate 12-15 force on your second turn every game.

Pull the Home One Docking Bay (If they didnt start with a scomp link for you), and pull R2D2 (for free). You should have a How did we get into this mess?, so once you drop all your Sites. Mess the rest, and repeat. Since you go first, they will not have the force to grab the mess until after they activate thier first force. Hopefully, the dark side gave you a few force so you can Mess more, or even draw up if you dont get a Mess. On thier turn, after they pull the grabber shield, play another mess. You want them to grab it, so Harvest, Clash of Sabers can get through.

A gift is a good way to get the bounty hunting decks hurt.  You can get Shmi with Slave Quarters and then Threepio with her. Then pull Gift with Don’t do that again and move Threepio over to Audience Chamber… and then where they have an alien their drains are -1 and battle destinies are -2…

Organa and They Win This Round…nice retrieval if nessary

Matchups:

Senate: Let them drop the Baron to space first. Make sure you have a solid hold on the Moisture Farm, and wait for them to come at you.

Yet...icebreath you have at admit it is quite creative?
